name: Boiler soot blower and online cleaning
description: Online cleaning equipment that removes ash and soot deposits from heat-transfer surfaces to preserve efficiency, keep flue-gas temperatures within design and prevent gas-passage blockage. Saturated steam is the most widely used blowing medium because boiler-generated steam is available; SCR catalyst cleaning uses much lower steam velocity to avoid mechanical or erosive damage.

specifications.basis: Saturated steam is the most widely used medium because boiler-generated steam avoids an external supply
Steam velocity is low compared with boiler sootblowing applications to avoid mechanical or erosive damage
